title: Essential smoothness under base change
statement: Let R,Q be commutative rings with carriers in Type u, and E a commutative R-algebra with carrier in Type v. Let R→Q be any algebra map. Suppose E is essentially smooth over R [def-weil-pbc-essentially-smooth-ring-map], meaning E is R-isomorphic to a localization of a smooth R-algebra. Then Q⊗_R E [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], with its canonical left Q-algebra structure, is essentially smooth over Q. No flatness or Noetherian hypothesis is required.

source.place: Tags 00DK (lemma-tensor-localization) and 00T4 (lemma-base-change-smooth), used in Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma 07FJ, item-eighth-resolve

proof.text: Write E as S⁻¹P for a smooth R-algebra P, transporting the P-algebra structure and the localization property along the given R-algebra equivalence.
Set P′=Q⊗_R P; smooth base change makes P′ smooth over Q.

Localization base change makes Q⊗_R E the localization of P′ at the image of S. The induced P′-algebra structure is the tensor of id_Q and P→E; its restriction to Q is the canonical one. Restrict the localization equivalence to Q to obtain an essentially smooth presentation. The constructed P′ lies in Type(max(u,v)), exactly the universe of the smooth model required for Q⊗_R E.
